profile.name: 软件位操作 SPI 接口
profile.description: 一种非物理的软件组件，通过 GPIO 以位操作方式实现本地 SPI 通信接口，可在实验控制与原型开发中与 SPI 外设进行基础数据交换。它依赖软件时序而非专用硬件 SPI 控制器，适合本地简易通信，不适合需要高性能或远程稳定事务处理的场景。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component that implements a local SPI communication interface by bit-banging GPIO pins. It is useful in lab control and prototyping for basic data exchange with SPI peripherals. It relies on software timing instead of a dedicated hardware SPI controller, making it suitable for simple local communication rather than high-performance or remote transaction handling.
